title: Supported ruthenium catalysts for the transformation of aqueous glycerol to hydrogen gas and lactic acid
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,106-118
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00213J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ankit Kumar, Bhanu Priya, Rohit Kumar Rai, Parveen Garg, Uday Deshpande, Sanjay Kumar Singh
We report the transformation of aqueous glycerol (GLY) to selectively produce high-purity H2 gas (productivity ∼12 L H2/gRu/h) and lactic acid (LA, yield 86%) over a supported Ru catalyst at 130 °C.
